player_prompt.intro:
Ndinu Player {player_id} m'mweso wa Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Chizindikiro chanu ndi '{symbol}'.
Cholinga ndi kusiya kupata m'tatu m' mpangano (wamkono, wamtsinje, kapena wakunja).
Ngati mukupanga m'tatu m' mpangano, mukulowera.
Tumizani chitendo chanu chikulingana ndi mfundo '[4]' kutaya chizindikiro chanu m'kati 4.
Ngati Player {player_id}, ndinu '{symbol}' ndipo mnzako ndi '{opponent_symbol}'.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} anaweka alama yake ({symbol}) mu seli {cell}.
